zh.title: 粗剪：先让片子成立
zh.summary: 粗剪只做一件事：让陌生人看懂谁想要什么、被什么挡住。节奏、调色、配乐都往后放。

zh.title: 声音：先对白，再音乐
zh.summary: 观众可以忍受画面粗糙，但很难忍受听不清。先把对白做干净，再谈音乐和氛围。

zh.title: 调色：先统一，再风格
zh.summary: 调色先解决白平衡、曝光和镜头匹配，再谈 LUT 和风格。镜头之间不连，风格越多越乱。

zh.title: 节奏不是快，是观众什么时候想听下一句
zh.summary: 剪得快不等于好看。先删解释，再把切点放在动作上，最后决定哪里该留安静。

zh.title: 声音后期先修噪声，再谈氛围
zh.summary: 一条片子的声音不舒服，观众不会说“声音不好”，只会说“看不下去”。先处理底噪、电平、同步，再考虑音乐。

zh.title: 合成：先让两层信同一种光
zh.summary: 抠得像不等于合得成。边缘之前，先对光的方向、软硬、色温和接触阴影。

zh.title: 声音先走：J-cut 与 L-cut
zh.summary: 画面切了，声音不必同时切。让下一场的声音先进来，或让上一场的声音留一会儿，硬切就不会撞观众一下。

zh.title: 字幕：让观众读完，不是逐字抄
zh.summary: 字幕不是台词的复制件。它要在观众还来不及读的时候，把意思送进去：一行别太长，一句话别断在错的地方，数字和名字要能一眼认出来。

zh.title: 剪辑点：让注意力过去
zh.summary: 剪不动，不一定素材不够，是切点没选对。一个镜头结束，观众的眼睛、耳朵或动作得有一个着落；三样都没有，切口就会跳。

zh.title: 混音：先让对白站住，再加音乐
zh.summary: 观众可以不听音乐，但不能听不清台词。先把对白压到同一水平，再把音乐推下去；音乐是背景，不是遮羞布。

zh.title: 环境音：别让画面住在真空里
zh.summary: 房间的声音不是噪声，是空间。每换一个地方，录三十秒空场；没有人声、没有动作，只有房间。对白一断，环境音接上，观众才不会觉得画面被剪断。

zh.title: 转场：不是遮住时间，是交代时间
zh.summary: 叠化、黑场、划像不是装饰。每一次转场都在回答：过了多久、去了哪里、谁还在。答不清，就硬切。

zh.title: 片头字：先读清，再谈酷
zh.summary: 片头字先保证读得清，再谈风格；观众连片名都没看清，设计就白做了。

zh.title: 代理流程：先能剪，再谈画质
zh.summary: 代理不是降低成片质量，是让剪辑先跑起来；原始素材永远留在旁边。

zh.title: 一级校正：曝光与白平衡
zh.summary: 一级校正先解决曝光和白平衡，别用风格掩盖技术问题。

zh.title: 响度：平台目标与真峰值
zh.summary: 响度按平台目标交付，真峰值留余量；声音大不等于声音好。

zh.title: 细剪：把粗剪的毛边修掉
zh.summary: 细剪不是加特效，是把每个切换、每句呼吸、每个多余半秒修顺。

zh.title: 平行剪辑：两条线什么时候交叉
zh.summary: 平行剪辑不是来回切，它要让两条线在观众心里产生一个问题：什么时候撞上。

zh.title: 版本管理：别用“final 真的 final”
zh.summary: 版本管理用日期、平台、时长和改动原因命名，别用“final 真的 final”。

zh.title: 色彩管理：把 LUT 放在正确的位置
zh.summary: 色彩管理不是套一个“电影感 LUT”。它先回答：素材是什么色彩空间、监视器是什么、交付是什么；再把转换放在正确的节点上。

zh.title: 二级校正：只改一块颜色
zh.summary: 二级校正只改一个区域：脸、天空、衣服；改得越多，越容易假。

zh.title: LUT：起点不是终点
zh.summary: LUT 是起点，不是终点；套完之后还要回到一级校正看黑位和高光。

zh.title: HDR：先有 HDR 的素材和监看
zh.summary: HDR 不是把 SDR 拉亮；拍摄、监看、交付都得真的支持 HDR。

zh.title: 示波器：黑位、白位、肤色
zh.summary: 示波器先看三件事：黑位有没有死、白位有没有爆、肤色线偏没偏。

zh.title: Foley：脚步、衣服、门把手
zh.summary: Foley 不是配背景音，它把画面里的动作重新做成声音：脚步、衣服、门把手。

zh.title: 配乐剪辑：让音乐跟着动作
zh.summary: 配乐不是从头铺到尾，它要在动作转折处进入、退出、留白。

zh.title: 抠像：先抠边缘，再调色
zh.summary: 抠像先看边缘，再看颜色；边缘糊了，调色救不回来。

zh.title: 跟踪：点要贴在实处
zh.summary: 跟踪点要贴在真实、有纹理、不被遮挡的位置；贴在纯色墙上一定漂。

zh.title: 遮罩：一笔一笔跟
zh.summary: 遮罩不是一拉就完，边缘穿过头发、手指、透明物时，只能一帧一帧修。

zh.title: 清理：去掉穿帮，不擦掉信息
zh.summary: 清理穿帮不是把画面擦空，而是去掉错误的东西，保留观众需要的信息。

zh.title: CG 合成：光、影、雾一起对
zh.summary: CG 合成先对光的方向、影子的软硬、空气的雾，再谈细节。

zh.title: 听障字幕：不只写对白
zh.summary: 听障字幕要写清说话人、环境声和重要音效，不只抄对白。

zh.title: 口述影像：把画面说给人听
zh.summary: 口述影像只讲看不见但必须知道的信息：谁在动、往哪走、手里是什么。

zh.title: 多语言字幕：别一行塞两种语言
zh.summary: 多语言字幕别一行塞两种语言；要么切换字幕轨，要么分版交付。

zh.title: 母版：交付前定一个唯一版本
zh.summary: 母版是唯一可信的交付源；平台版、竖版、字幕版都从它派生。

zh.title: 归档：三年后还能打开
zh.summary: 归档不是把文件拖进硬盘，是保证三年后还能找到、还能打开、还能改。

zh.title: 技术检查：黑帧、静帧、断音
zh.summary: 技术检查按清单看：黑帧、静帧、断音、字幕越界、声道错位。

zh.title: 项目结构：文件夹比软件重要
zh.summary: 项目结构先定文件夹和命名，软件换了还能找到素材。

zh.title: 代理与缓存：别让硬盘先满
zh.summary: 代理和缓存要放在独立盘，别让剪辑盘先满；满了就会掉帧。

zh.title: 备份恢复：演一次恢复
zh.summary: 备份不是复制完就算，随机抽一个文件恢复一次，才算验证。

zh.title: HDR 全流程：从监看到交付，不要只在最后加亮
zh.summary: HDR 不是把 SDR 拉亮，而是从拍摄、监看、调色到平台交付都保留同一套亮度关系。任何一个环节按 SDR 猜，最后都会得到“亮但平”的画面。

zh.title: Conform / Online：套底、回批与母版
zh.summary: Conform 不是把剪辑时间线换个软件打开。它要确认每一刀都回到原始素材、每一段都有足够 handles、每一个版本都能回到同一条母版。

zh.title: 声音后期：从对白到终混的顺序
zh.summary: 声音后期不是先找音乐。顺序是：对白能听清、环境不断、效果不抢、音乐最后进；每一步都有可检查的结果。

zh.title: DIT 与数据交接：现场到后期的第一次交接
zh.summary: DIT 不是拷卡。它要保证每张卡有校验、每份素材有三份、每个文件名能回到场记、每个代理能对应原素材。

zh.title: 平台多版本交付：一版母版，多版安全区
zh.summary: 一版通投是最贵的省事。母版只有一个，平台版按画幅、时长、字幕、响度和封面分别派生；每个版本都能回到母版。

zh.title: 归档与资产复用：让下一条片子更快
zh.summary: 归档不是把文件夹拖进硬盘。它要让下一个人能打开工程、找到素材、知道授权、恢复调色和声音；复用不是翻旧片，是有索引地取用。

zh.title: 资产管理：结构、代理、版本
zh.summary: 后期效率不是软件快，而是项目结构、代理和版本让每个人都知道最新文件在哪。

zh.title: 剪辑节奏：精剪、并行、音乐
zh.summary: 节奏不是切得快，而是精剪、并行场景和音乐在同一拍上推进。

zh.title: 色彩管线：管理、一级、LUT
zh.summary: 色彩不是套 LUT；管理、一级校正和 LUT 的顺序错了，越调越脏。

zh.title: 声音混音：对白、响度、拟音
zh.summary: 混音不是把声音调大；对白、响度和拟音要各就各位，观众才不累。

zh.title: 字幕交付：SDH、多语、音频描述
zh.summary: 字幕不是把字打上去；SDH、多语和音频描述是三种不同的观众任务。

zh.title: 母版交付：Master、QC、平台
zh.summary: 交付不是导出一个文件；母版、QC 和平台规格要一次对齐，否则上线后还要返工。

zh.title: 对白剪辑：让停顿说话
zh.summary: 对白剪辑不是把声音接顺，是选择观众什么时候听到反应、什么时候听见沉默。

zh.title: 远程审片：版本、标注与回批
zh.summary: 远程审片不是发一个链接，是让版本、时间码、标注和回批都能被追踪；否则每条语音都会变成一次返工。

en.title: The Rough Cut: Make the Film Work First
en.summary: A rough cut does one thing: let a stranger understand who wants what and what blocks them. Rhythm, grade, and score come later.

en.title: Sound: Dialogue First, Music Later
en.summary: An audience can forgive a rough image, but not dialogue they cannot hear. Clean the voice first, then add music and atmosphere.

en.title: Color: Match First, Style Second
en.summary: Fix white balance, exposure, and shot matching before LUTs and looks. If shots do not match, more style only makes it messier.

en.title: Pacing Is Not Speed; It Is When They Want the Next Line
en.summary: Fast cuts do not make a film good. Cut the explanation, land cuts on movement, then decide where silence belongs.

en.title: Fix the Noise Before You Build a Mood
en.summary: When a film sounds uncomfortable, the audience rarely says “the sound is bad.” They just stop watching. Fix noise, levels, and sync before reaching for music.

en.title: Compositing: Make Both Layers Believe the Same Light
en.summary: A clean key is not a composite. Match direction, softness, color temperature, and contact shadow before touching the edge.

en.title: Let Sound Cross the Cut: J-cuts and L-cuts
en.summary: Picture does not have to cut at the same time as sound. Let the next scene arrive early, or the last one linger, and the cut stops hitting the audience.

en.title: Subtitles: Help Them Read, Not Just Transcribe
en.summary: Subtitles are not a transcript. They have to land the meaning before the eye gives up: short lines, breaks at the right place, numbers and names that read at a glance.

en.title: Cut Points: Action, Eye Line, Sound
en.summary: A scene that will not cut usually has the wrong cut point, not too little footage. At every cut, the eye, the ear, or an action needs somewhere to land.

en.title: Mixing: Land the Dialogue Before the Music
en.summary: The audience can ignore the music; they cannot afford to miss the line. Level the dialogue first, then push the music down. Music is background, not a cover-up.

en.title: Room Tone: Do Not Let the Picture Live in a Vacuum
en.summary: The room's sound is not noise; it is the space. In every location, record thirty seconds of nothing: no voices, no movement, just the room. When the dialogue stops, room tone takes over, and the cut stops sounding like a cut.

en.title: Transitions: Mark Time, Do Not Hide It
en.summary: A dissolve, a fade, a wipe is not decoration. Every transition answers: how long, where, and who is still here. If it cannot answer, hard cut.

en.title: Title Design: Readable Before Cool
en.summary: Title design must be readable before it is cool; if the name is missed, the style is wasted.

en.title: Proxy Workflow: Cut First, Quality Later
en.summary: Proxies do not lower the final quality; they let the edit move. Keep the originals untouched.

en.title: Primary Correction: Exposure and White Balance
en.summary: Primary correction fixes exposure and white balance first. Do not hide technical problems under a look.

en.title: Loudness: Platform Target and True Peak
en.summary: Deliver to the platform's loudness target and leave true-peak headroom. Loud is not good.

en.title: Fine Cut: Remove the Rough Edges
en.summary: Fine cutting is not adding effects; it smooths every cut, breath, and extra half-second.

en.title: Parallel Editing: When Do Two Lines Meet?
en.summary: Parallel editing is not back-and-forth; it makes the audience ask when the two lines will collide.

en.title: Versioning: Never Name It Final
en.summary: Name versions by date, platform, duration, and change reason. Never "final final."

en.title: Color Management: Put the LUT in the Right Place
en.summary: Color management is not applying a cinematic LUT. It answers what the source space is, what the monitor is, and what delivery needs, then puts the transform on the right node.

en.title: Secondary Correction: Change One Area
en.summary: Secondary correction changes one area: skin, sky, wardrobe. More areas, more fake.

en.title: LUT: A Starting Point, Not a Finish
en.summary: A LUT is a start, not a finish. Return to primary correction and check blacks and highlights.

en.title: HDR: You Need HDR on Set and in the Room
en.summary: HDR is not a brighter SDR; capture, monitoring, and delivery must all support it.

en.title: Scopes: Black, White, Skin
en.summary: Scopes answer three things: dead blacks, clipped whites, and skin line drift.

en.title: Foley: Steps, Cloth, Doors
en.summary: Foley does not add ambience; it rebuilds the sound of visible action: steps, cloth, handles.

en.title: Music Editing: Let the Music Follow the Action
en.summary: Music does not run wall to wall; it enters, exits, and leaves space at the turn.

en.title: Keying: Edge First, Color Second
en.summary: Keying checks edges before color. If the edge is mush, grading cannot save it.

en.title: Tracking: Put the Point on Something Real
en.summary: Put tracking points on real, textured, unoccluded surfaces; a flat wall will drift.

en.title: Rotoscoping: One Frame at a Time
en.summary: Rotoscoping is not one drag. Hair, fingers, and transparency need frame-by-frame work.

en.title: Cleanup: Remove the Mistake, Keep the Information
en.summary: Cleanup removes the mistake, not the information the audience needs.

en.title: CG Integration: Match Light, Shadow, Atmosphere
en.summary: CG integration matches light direction, shadow softness, and atmosphere before detail.

en.title: SDH: More Than Dialogue
en.summary: SDH names speakers, ambience, and important effects; it does not just transcribe dialogue.

en.title: Audio Description: Say What Matters
en.summary: Audio description says what is invisible but necessary: who moves, where, and what they hold.

en.title: Multilingual Subtitles: One Language at a Time
en.summary: Do not stack two languages in one line; switch tracks or deliver separate versions.

en.title: Mastering: One File to Rule the Delivery
en.summary: The master is the single trusted source; platform, vertical, and subtitled versions derive from it.

en.title: Archive: Open It in Three Years
en.summary: Archiving is not dragging files to a drive; it means findable, openable, and editable in three years.

en.title: QC: Black Frames, Frozen Frames, Dead Audio
en.summary: QC follows a list: black frames, freezes, audio drops, subtitle overflow, channel swaps.

en.title: Project Structure: Folders Beat Software
en.summary: Set folders and naming before software; if the app changes, the media still makes sense.

en.title: Proxy and Cache: Do Not Fill the Drive First
en.summary: Keep proxies and cache on a separate drive; a full edit drive drops frames.

en.title: Backup Recovery: Rehearse One Restore
en.summary: Backup is not finished when the copy ends; restore one random file to prove it.

en.title: HDR End to End: Do Not Just Brighten at the End
en.summary: HDR is not brightening SDR. It preserves one luminance relationship from capture through monitoring, grading, and delivery. Guess in SDR at any stage and the result is bright but flat.

en.title: Conform and Online: Relink, Round-Trip, and Master
en.summary: Conform is not opening the edit in another app. It verifies every cut returns to the original media, every clip has enough handles, and every version traces to one master.

en.title: Sound Post: The Order from Dialogue to Final Mix
en.summary: Sound post does not start with music. The order is: dialogue audible, ambience continuous, effects supporting, music last; each step has a checkable result.

en.title: DIT and Data Handoff: The First Handoff from Set to Post
en.summary: DIT is not card copying. It guarantees checksums, three copies, filenames that trace to the log, and proxies that match source.

en.title: Platform Deliverables: One Master, Many Safe Areas
en.summary: One master everywhere is the most expensive shortcut. Keep one master, derive platform versions by frame, runtime, captions, loudness, and cover; every version traces back.

en.title: Archive and Asset Reuse: Make the Next Film Faster
en.summary: Archiving is not dragging a folder onto a drive. It lets the next person open the project, find media, know the rights, and restore grade and sound. Reuse is indexed retrieval, not digging through old films.

en.title: Asset management: structure, proxies, versions
en.summary: Post speed is not software; project structure, proxies and versions tell everyone where the latest file is.

en.title: Edit rhythm: fine cut, parallel, music
en.summary: Rhythm is not fast cutting; fine cut, parallel scenes and music advance on the same beat.

en.title: Colour pipeline: management, primary, LUT
en.summary: Colour is not a LUT; wrong order of management, primary and LUT makes it dirtier.

en.title: Sound mix: dialogue, loudness, foley
en.summary: Mixing is not making it louder; dialogue, loudness and foley need their places so the audience is not tired.

en.title: Subtitle delivery: SDH, multilingual, audio description
en.summary: Subtitles are not typing; SDH, multilingual and audio description are three different audience tasks.

en.title: Master delivery: master, QC, platform
en.summary: Delivery is not one export; master, QC and platform specs must align once or the launch comes back.

en.title: Dialogue Editing: Let the Pause Speak
en.summary: Dialogue editing is not smoothing audio. It is choosing when the audience hears a reaction and when it hears silence.

en.title: Remote Review: Versions, Notes, Turnaround
en.summary: Remote review is not sending a link. It makes versions, timecode, notes and turnaround traceable; otherwise every voice message becomes a rework.
